description: Figure 4 is a line plot comparing the Macro-F1 scores of two tokenization models — “MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information” — as the number of tokens used during training varies. The x-axis, labeled “Number of tokens,” ranges from approximately 0.6 to 1.5, representing multiples of the original token count (as noted in the text, varied from 0.5x to 1.5x). The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, spans from 48 to 58, with major tick marks at intervals of 2. The “MATTER (ours)” model is represented by a solid pink line with circular markers and a light pink shaded area indicating variance or confidence interval; it starts at approximately 55.2% at 0.6x tokens, peaks near 58% at 1.0x, and declines to about 51% at 1.5x. The “w/o material information” model is shown as a solid purple line with circular markers and a light purple shaded area; it begins at roughly 52.8% at 0.6x, remains relatively flat around 53–54% until 1.4x, then drops sharply to approximately 47.5% at 1.5x. Both lines exhibit some fluctuation across the token range, but MATTER consistently outperforms the baseline across nearly all token counts, especially at higher token volumes.
